items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: No, Excelsior was this, uh... That was the Pope's band.

ctx.x: Was that Eureka or Excelsior, do you remember?

And they had a Eureka band, too. Yes. I didn't know it.
